oracle_provenance: Standard statistical hypothesis-testing z-score arithmetic (uncertainty propagation); independently hand-verified before implementation. Not copied from any shared Skill fixture.
scope: Bounded significance check for two independent measurements with declared uncertainty; not a matched-conditions guarantee or a full statistical study.

cases.question: With tight uncertainties and a 2-unit difference, does the z-score clearly exceed the significance threshold?
With looser uncertainties and a smaller difference, does the z-score fall below threshold, correctly treated as inconclusive rather than a real difference?
Must a zero declared uncertainty (implying infinite z-score) be rejected rather than silently used?
When the two measurements are swapped, does the z-score flip sign while keeping the same magnitude, confirming the model correctly tracks direction rather than just magnitude?
